svg.title: StateKV: physical oracle → direct layer-adaptive cache control
svg.desc: A publication-style system architecture with an observed compressed state on the left, an expensive physical oracle lane and a training-free B3 direct-controller lane in the center, a layer-wise cache action and next token on the right, a state feedback loop, and evidence milestones from P26, P31, and P32.

g.text: StateKV: physical oracle → direct layer-adaptive cache control
History-conditioned actions share one evolving state; B3 emits one layer-wise action without candidate model rollouts.
legal retained sets at budget B
one risk object for action and staleness
evaluation reference · not an inference input
one action · zero candidate model rollouts
high q means expensive to evict
Qwen3-8B P31/P32 setting: 10 sequences · 64 generated tokens · nominal 256-token layer budget
selected MLX state is carried across periods
all five tested NIAH needles preserved
fixed global allocation; best task-score point estimate
separate dynamic control from static priors
dynamic vs static · shuffled · stale budgets
irreversible eviction without CPU cold recovery
